_meta.geocode_gap: lat/lng remain hand-estimated (geocode_status='approx'). A true geocoder (Census Bureau / Google Geocoding API) could not be run in this environment, so coordinates were NOT machine-geocoded this pass. Ivy Hall coords were refined to its now-known street address. REMAINING GAP: Code should run each 'address' through a geocoder and set geocode_status='geocoded' before any hard radius filter.
caveats: lat/lng are approximate (hand-estimated from address); see geocode_gap. Code MUST geocode each address before any hard radius filter.
